## About

Rabin R is a Senior Frontend Angular Consultant with 4+ years of experience building high-performance web and mobile applications. Specialized in Angular (Zoneless + Signals), TypeScript, React, Next.js, and creating seamless user experiences.

Expertise:
- Angular Architecture & Performance
- Frontend Engineering & Product Design
- Web Performance Optimization
- Design Systems & Component Architecture
- React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js
- Ionic Mobile Apps (iOS/Android)

## Notable Work

### Fiji Immigration Internal Management System
High-consequence government case management platform serving 10,000+ users. Built with Angular, TypeScript, and modern web standards.

### Fiji Immigration Citizen Portal
Public-facing citizen management portal for the Fiji Government's Immigration Department.

### PRIMS Member Portal
Pension member portal with member account management and portal services.

### VNPF Pension Mobile App
Cross-platform iOS/Android Ionic application for pension member access.
